title: Cogent Security, which aims to use AI agents to decide which software bugs to remediate, raised a $42M Series A led by Bain, taking its total raised to $53M (Lily Mae Lazarus/Fortune)
summary: Lily Mae Lazarus / Fortune: Cogent Security, which aims to use AI agents to decide which software bugs to remediate, raised a $42M Series A led by Bain, taking its total raised to $53M — Cogent Security has raised a $42 million Series A just six months after launch.
